maya: Hey team — quick runbook update for tomorrow's all-hands (10:00 AM PT). Two changes: camera in Conf D is acting up, and we swapped the roadmap slide deck order. Read below and flag if you need anything. :clipboard:

sam: Thanks Maya. For the camera, can we switch to the mobile backup in Conf A? I can bring a gimbal and laptop for OBS if needed.

maya: @sam yes please. Plan B is mobile rig -> HDMI capture dongle on ops laptop. Will add to checklist.

infra-bot: Recording job queued: allhands-2026-05-10 | recorder v2.4 | status: pending

liam: FYI the RTMP ingest we usually use (rtmp://live.redwood/capture) had intermittent timeouts last week. Ops, do we have a fallback ingest endpoint?

devops: We have rtmp://live-redwood-fallback/ready — it's lower bandwidth but stable. We'll test 30m before show. :white_check_mark:

ash: For slides — who's doing the final deck swap? I can be on deck to update order and confirm slide numbers.

maya: @ash you got it. Swap: move "Dedicated" before "Optimize" and add one slide with the new SLA blurb (from #product thread).

sophia: Quick QA for leadership Q&A flow: can we reserve 7 mins for live questions and 8 mins for pre-submitted that Patrick will curate?

patrick: yep I'll curate pre-submitted and call time. Also prepping 3 backup Qs in case chat is quiet.

maya: Recording fallback plan in steps (copying into thread):
1) Primary: Conf D camera -> HDMI -> ops laptop OBS -> RTMP primary
2) If camera fails: mobile backup in Conf A -> HDMI capture -> ops laptop OBS -> RTMP primary
3) If RTMP primary times out: switch OBS to rtmp://live-redwood-fallback/ready
4) If video can't be rescued: start audio-only Zoom recording & upload to S3 + post link in #all-hands

liam: can someone add the actual commands for restarting the recorder app? save time during a panic.

devops: putting commands here — tested on ops laptop (ubuntu 22.04):
```
# restart OBS and recorder service
pkill -f obs || true
/usr/bin/obs --startvirtualcam &
sudo systemctl restart recorder.service
journalctl -u recorder.service -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 80
```

maya: perfect. @devops please attach the VM credentials to the runbook (securely) and confirm access for @sam and @ash.

devops: done — shared via 1Password item "all-hands/recorders" and granted view to sam, ash, maya, patrick.

ash: I'll be at the ops laptop 25 minutes before show to verify camera angle and slide deck order. @patrick can you ping me when pre-submitted Qs are final?

patrick: will do. ETA 9:40 AM PT for curated Q list.

sophia: One last product question for the leadership segment — can we confirm if the roadmap slide will include the tentative timeline for the batching/caching feature? I got mixed signals in product sync.

maya: We'll include an "ETA: Q3 tentative" footnote and note it's subject to change. Keep it high-level.

sam: minor note — audio monitoring: bring wired earbuds (no bluetooth) to avoid latency. I'll supply a headphone splitter for panel.

infra-bot: Recording job update: allhands-2026-05-10 | recorder v2.4 | status: scheduled | attempt: 1 | start_window: 09:35:00 PT

liam: thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, drop it in this thread rather than creating a new one — will keep ops consolidated. :pray:

maya: thanks team — appreciate the quick responses. See you all tomorrow, bright and early. :sun_with_face:
